title: Ali's Composure Under Threat
paragraphs: Facing a genuinely life-threatening situation during the migration to Madinah, Ali agreed to sleep in the Prophet's bed as a deliberate decoy, fully aware that assassins might discover and attack him instead.

Rather than expressing visible fear or hesitation about the considerable personal risk involved, he calmly proceeded with the plan, prioritizing the community's safety over his own immediate physical security.

When the assassins eventually discovered the deception the following morning, Ali maintained his composure, answering their questions honestly without providing any information that could endanger the Prophet's escape route.

His willingness to accept substantial personal risk without complaint or hesitation became one of several defining moments that shaped his later reputation for courage and unwavering loyalty within the community.

Contemporary accounts describe his calm demeanor throughout the ordeal as particularly remarkable, given the genuine uncertainty about whether he would survive the immediate confrontation that followed the discovery.

This episode is frequently cited today when discussing courage under pressure, illustrating that genuine bravery often looks less like fearlessness and more like calm, deliberate action despite very real fear.
